text: ねてしまうと　その　あいだは　こうげき　できません！

structure.jp: こうげき　できません！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often when you don't want it to. ねてしまう = 'ends up falling asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'if' or 'whenever' that happens, the next thing follows. ねてしまうと = 'if it falls asleep'.

patterns.name: 〜あいだ
patterns.explanation: あいだ means the stretch of time while something lasts. その あいだは = 'during that time'.
